'''Bastogard''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Watchroo]] at 18 stars, and evolves into [[Cratzar]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Bastogard once struck gold underground. After hearing how valuable it used to be in the human world, a fortress was dug out to store the precious ore."

Bastogard is a red rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A rodent which is usually underground, with just its upper body out from its burrow. It's surrounded by sandcastles, with the one behind it topped with a red flag. Bastogard has grey-brown fur, an off-white underside, and a pink nose and claws/feet.

Bastogard's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its fur to dark blue, and the flag on its head becomes purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Bastogard's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 36 stars. To evolve it into [[Cratzar]] you need to complete the following three tasks:
* Raise this Tatari to B quality.
* Play [[Treasure Hunt]] (dig up 120 treasure) or [[Cozy Farm]] (use x7200 fertilizer).
* Obtain 50 more Tatari Wishboxes.

== Trivia ==
* Old Bio: "Bastogard borrowed candy to get its big fort. It needs to fight [[Zobos]] for 30 years to pay it off."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Bastogard took out a candy loan to pay for the big fort. Now that's 30 years of Zobo fighting to pay it back..."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Builds castle-like earthen walls around the body, hiding inside while judging passing Tatari. Mocking others is Bastogard's greatest pleasure."
